messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — I'm seeing customer reports that embeddings from model-rw-7b are off after SDK upgrade 1.4.2 -> 1.5.0. Can we pin the hosted SDK while we investigate?
Maria Gomez: Which endpoint / customers? Any failing prod traces or just internal canary?
Alex Chen: CS forwarded issues from tenant 'atlas'. Repro in our canary: generated metadata fields are hallucinated. Unit tests pass but eval metrics drop ~6% on our smoke prompts.
TJ Park: @Alex can you paste a minimal repro? Also FYI the SDK PR (#4321) merged earlier today 04:12 UTC.
Alex Chen: Repro snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., sdk_version='1.5.0')
vec = client.embed('Invoice #123\nTotal: $45.50')
print(vec[:3])
```
Outputs don't match 1.4.2 baseline.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: SDK 1.5.0 rollout -> hosted-api (canary 5%) by Maria (pr/4321)
Maria Gomez: I can put a temporary pin to 1.4.2 for hosted if we want. That will block 1.5.0 features until we unpin.
Anna (QA): I'll run the regression suite against 1.5.0 on canary nodes now, ETA ~30m.
SRE Oncall: If we pin, please schedule a short change window to revert later. Also add latency watch; batching changes sometimes affect p99.
Devex-bot: Note: SDK pin requires client-compat flag + small routing tweak. Ops runbook: https://wiki/redwood/sdk-pinning (internal)
Alex Chen: +1 pin. Also capture runtime kernel versions and tokenizer hashes — there might be coupling between SDK tokenization and runtime kernels.
TJ Park: 1.5.0 introduced a batching/tokenization optimization that touches whitespace normalization. Could affect embeddings. I'll bisect tokenizer diffs.
Maria Gomez: I'll apply a canary pin first (5%) and validate.
deploy-bot: Pin applied (canary): hosted-api routing -> sdk=1.4.2 for 5% traffic. Rollout id: R-9876
Alex Chen: Verified: repro goes away on canary. Errors drop back to baseline.
Anna (QA): Regression suite: 1.5.0 shows embedding drift on 3 tests: inv-parse, invoice-total, address-parse. Full logs uploaded: /artifacts/ci/4321/regression.json
SRE Oncall: Recommend informing CS and posting a status note. Also we should add a short-circuit fallback: if eval-quality drops by >5% route to pinned SDK.
Maria Gomez: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up PR to add an automatic fallback policy. Tagging owners: @TJ Park @Li (tokenizer).
TJ Park: I'll bisect tokenizer changes now. ETA ~2h.
Alex Chen: Proposal: keep global pin for 24h while we triage; then either ship 1.5.1 (patch) and unpin, or roll back to 1.4.2 if needed. Thoughts?
SRE Oncall: Fine. I'll set change window: 2026-03-12 18:00-18:30 UTC for unpin/rollback ops.
deploy-bot: Pin promoted: hosted-api routing -> sdk=1.4.2 for 100% traffic. Rollout id: R-9877
Maria Gomez: Done. Notifying CS + publishing customer-facing note in #customer-status. :white_check_mark:
Devex-bot: Reminder: please add a compatibility note in the SDK changelog and a brief release-note entry describing the model/tokenizer coupling.
Alex Chen: Filed tracking issue INF-2219 with repro and eval deltas: https://issues/redwood/INF-2219
Anna (QA): I'll re-run the full eval after TJ's bisect and attach artifacts.
TJ Park: Found culprit: tokenizer normalization changed whitespace-preserving rule in v2 which shifted token boundaries. Patch PR incoming with test vectors.
Maria Gomez: Plan: cut 1.5.1 with tokenizer patch, smoke on canary, if pass then unpin.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Keep this thread updated; close once 1.5.1 verified and pin removed. :thumbsup:
